source.prompt: best ERP for travel agency with booking and accounting
source.note: real collected answer; brand, competitors and publishers are the specs the cycle was scored with

answer.text:
The best ERP software for a travel agency depends on whether you run outbound leisure tours, corporate travel, or incoming destination management (DMC). Because travel accounting involves complex split-payments, supplier payables, and commission tracking, purpose-built systems beat generic accounting tools every time.

| ERP Platform | Best For | Core Strengths | Accounting & Booking Focus |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Lemax** | Mid-to-large Tour Operators & DMCs | End-to-end itinerary builder, supplier management, dynamic pricing | Native travel accounting, direct supplier invoicing, commission tracking |
| **Trawex** | B2B / B2C Agencies needing GDS integration | Massive API integrations (Amadeus, Sabre), multi-currency booking engine | Automated payment gateway reconciliation, dynamic markup management |
| **Odoo (Travel ERP)** | Budget-conscious agencies wanting open-source flexibility | Highly customizable, modular structure, strong CRM integration | Enterprise-grade core accounting, custom invoice workflows |
| **Dolphin Dynamics** | Mid-sized independent agencies & corporate travel | Exceptional back-office reconciliation, automated mid-office flows | Industry-standard BSP/ARC reconciliation, automated client invoicing |
| **TravelWorks** | Small to mid-sized travel agencies | User-friendly, compliance-focused travel accounting | Automated BSP settlement, sub-agent commission distribution |

---

**1. Lemax**
* **Why it fits:** It is one of the most complete travel ERPs on the market, handling both B2B and B2C workflows.
* **Booking:** Pulls live inventory from GDS and hotel APIs, generates custom itineraries, and manages group reservations.
* **Accounting:** Built-in multi-currency sub-ledgers. It tracks supplier deposits, client payments, partial balances, and profit margins per booking automatically.

**2. Trawex**
* **Why it fits:** Ideal for agencies looking for heavy booking engine capabilities paired with operational backend management.
* **Booking:** Direct integration with major Global Distribution Systems (GDS) like Sabre and Amadeus, plus third-party hotel wholesalers.
* **Accounting:** Tracks complex dynamic markups, sub-agent commission structures, and multi-currency payment processing.

**3. Odoo (Custom Travel Module)**
* **Why it fits:** Outstanding for companies that want full ownership of their software and lower subscription overhead.
* **Booking:** Requires a travel-specific third-party Odoo app (e.g., from O2B Technologies or Webkul) to add tour management features.
* **Accounting:** Includes one of the strongest built-in open-source accounting engines available, featuring automated bank feeds, general ledger management, and financial reporting.

**4. Dolphin Dynamics**
* **Why it fits:** Extremely popular among European and UK agencies for back-office accuracy and flight reconciliation.
* **Booking:** Integrates mid-office reservation flows, managing flight tickets, hotel vouchers, and transfer bookings smoothly.
* **Accounting:** Specialized in automated BSP (Billing and Settlement Plan) reconciliation, agency credit control, and supplier payables.

---

**Alternative Approach: Modular Setup**
If dedicated ERPs feel too complex, many agencies pair a specialized travel management/booking tool (**TBO, TravelCRM, or Travefy**) with standard accounting software (**QuickBooks Online** or **Xero** via API integration).
